G1866.name: Epaenetus
G1866.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G1866.brief: A believer in Asia and beloved by Paul.
G1866.short: Epaenetus was the first convert to Christ in Asia and was beloved by Paul.

G1889.name: Epaphras
G1889.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G1889.brief: A faithful minister and fellow servant of Paul.
G1889.short: Epaphras was a faithful minister of Christ and a fellow prisoner with Paul, who labored in prayer for the Colossians.

G1891.name: Epaphroditus
G1891.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G1891.brief: A messenger and minister to Paul from Philippi.
G1891.short: Epaphroditus was a beloved brother, fellow worker, and fellow soldier who ministered to Paul's needs on behalf of the Philippians.
